reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on well-known protective oxide formation (Cr, Al) but does not explain how high entropy specifically enables the combination of low density with strength, nor does it address the trade-off that Al/Cr additions increase density.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares alloys with and without Cr/Al, but the baseline is vaguely defined and the falsification criterion is weak because Cr/Al are already known to improve oxidation/corrosion in many alloys, so a null result would not clearly falsify the high-entropy mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is too generic and restates established knowledge about Cr and Al in oxidation/corrosion without offering a novel, testable mechanistic insight specific to lightweight high-entropy alloys.
